# Total Home Appliance Repair

> Total Home Appliance Repair is the residential appliance repair brand of Top Speed Appliance LLC, serving Florida's tri-county area (Broward, Palm Beach and Miami-Dade counties). Every request is routed through Top Speed Service OS and confirmed by a real person in the Service Setters office.

## Contact

- Phone: (844) 460-7038
- Office: 6810 N State Rd 7, Suite 341, Coconut Creek, FL 33073
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM
- Website: https://totalhomeappliance.com/

## Services

- Refrigerator repair
- Washer repair
- Dryer repair
- Oven and range repair
- Dishwasher repair
- Freezer and ice maker repair
- Microwave repair
- Garbage disposal repair
- Appliance installation

## Pricing (residential)

- A diagnostic visit is collected at booking and credited in full toward your approved repair.
- Repair and installation labor are flat-rate.
- Parts and materials are priced in a written quote. No work is done without an approved written quote.
- Commercial service is priced by custom quote only — see Appliance Pro (https://www.appliancepro.net/).

## Coverage

- 65 cities across Broward (31), Palm Beach (16) and Miami-Dade (18) counties are matched automatically when booking; 104 city pages are published in total.
- Coverage directory: https://topspeedserviceos.com/service-areas-directory/

## Booking

- Book online with the booking form at https://totalhomeappliance.com/ — a Service Setter confirms every job before a technician is dispatched, and every job is tracked live from request to completion.
- Refer & Earn program: https://topspeedserviceos.com/refer
